predecessors.name: Jin (Korean state)
predecessors.text: Mahan, one of the three states that 'succeeded' Jin

successors.name: Baekje
successors.text: Baekje's first Cliopatria shape, identical to Mahan's

ledger.x: 91 BCE: the Mahan confederacy of 54 statelets appears in the south-west, with Mokji (Cheonan) at its head.
346: Baekje takes the rest of Mahan.

wars.name: Lelang and Daifang against the Han state (246)
wars.outcome: The Han state fell in struggles with Lelang and Daifang; the page does not say what land changed hands.

wars.name: Baekje's absorption of Mahan
wars.outcome: Baekje rose inside Mahan, overthrew the Mokji state and absorbed the confederacy; the last southern societies were annexed in Geunchogo's reign (346-375).

certainty.note: A loose confederacy of 54 statelets with no frontier on any page; the Cliopatria outline is a block of the south-west.
